IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House General Government Appropriations (originally sponsored by Representatives McCoy, Appleton, Chase, Van De Wege, Hunt, and Moeller)

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to human remains; adding a new section to chapter43.334 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.334 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The director of the department of archaeology and historicpreservation shall adopt the necessary rules to implement chapter 275,Laws of 2008.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2009, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
